rationale: W1, data-informed direct revision (not zero-shot). Rewrites the extinction network from observed train knees (normal branch at D_ext/D0 about 0.45; radiative branch past a critical size that falls with lean oxygen, CO2, He and low pressure), couples the run offset into extinction so a droplet that has already stopped shrinking is forecast as extinguished, and corrects the rate law where the train table shows a systematic ratio (lean oxygen, large droplets, water sag, heat-up). Train detail was read; of validation only the aggregate comparison of W0 was seen. See edits.wsp.
